Application Data.NAME: Crafty Creations Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Crafty Creations Inc. is a retail store specializing in a wide range of craft and hobby supplies, including model-building kits, paints, adhesives, tools, and accessories. The store offers instructional workshops and classes focused on various crafting techniques, ensuring a safe and engaging environment for customers. We maintain strict inventory control measures with regular audits, and our premises are well-maintained, featuring clear aisles and adherence to local safety codes. Our strong safety record demonstrates our commitment to minimizing risks for both customers and employees, allowing us to provide a comprehensive range of products and services without exposure to hazardous materials.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, Crafty Creations Inc. experienced a water leak from a faulty pipe in the storeroom, which caused damage to inventory and the store's flooring. Total estimated loss amounts to $1,500. The incident was reported to the insurance company, and the claim is currently in process.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, UL Rated, Keyed Lock
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: High-security fencing, 24-hour monitored alarm system, and regular patrols by licensed security personnel.
